text.title: 玻璃后的一束光
text.situation:
光学展台上，一束光穿过固定透镜，落到白色圆盘上。激光装置封闭在玻璃后，控制器不供游客触及。小展牌把这一学科称为光学。乔沿柜外移动，查看光落在何处。相邻的仪表架上，仪表有指针和数字刻度，旁边的气压计测量气压。玛雅画下圆盘和两个仪表表面；形状相似不代表用途相同。

乔：圆盘在测气压吗？
工作人员：不是，气压计做这件事。
玛雅：我们能调整激光吗？
工作人员：游客在这里观察光学展台，控制器留在柜内。

paragraphs.en: At the optical display, a line of light crossed a fixed lens and reached a white disc. The laser was enclosed behind glass, with the controls out of visitors’ reach. A small board called the subject optics. Jo moved along the outside of the case to see where the light ended. On the adjoining instrument shelf, a gauge had a needle and numbered marks. The barometer beside it measured air pressure. Maya sketched the round disc and the two instrument faces; similar shapes did not mean that they had the same job.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Is that disc measuring the air pressure?
Attendant: No. The barometer does that.
Maya: Can we adjust the laser?
Attendant: Visitors can observe the optical display from here. The controls remain inside the case.
